title: Delayed human review and bounded prototype verdict
question: Does the already-frozen PB.6 three-shot review slice communicate its bounded story action, shot progression and close ending clearly enough to close this one prototype slice without expanding the claim?

reviewer.identity: the current user, self-asserted when submitting the response

knownVisualObservationsDisclosed: The wide shot has notable foreground structural occlusion.
The medium shot presents the core at a relatively large scale.
disclosureOrder.rule: Do not change the media, questions, allowed answers, mappings, PB.6 evidence or frame-288 boundary after the human response.

questions.prompt: Is the story action legible: the guardian approaches, makes contact, the core lights, and the close ending reads as an intentional final beat?
Are the WIDE, MEDIUM and CLOSE progression and both cuts clearly distinguishable?
Is the close ending readable and not dominated by accidental occlusion?
Is this acceptable as a bounded product-prototype demonstration, without treating it as final-film quality?

optionalQuestion.prompt: Optional defect notes in the reviewer's own words.

humanVerdictMapping.FAIL: At least one Q1-Q4 answer is NO.
humanVerdictMapping.BLOCKED: There is no NO, but at least one Q1-Q4 answer is UNCERTAIN or UNVIEWABLE, or no complete response is available.

overallVerdictMapping.PASS: PB.6 machine verdict is PASS and PB.7 human verdict is PASS.
overallVerdictMapping.FAIL: The machine verdict is FAIL or the human verdict is FAIL.
overallVerdictMapping.BLOCKED: PB.6 machine verdict is PASS and the human verdict is BLOCKED or unavailable.

operationCeilings.researchEvidenceWrites: Only the fresh PB.7 evidence root and versioned research state may be written.

stopRules: Do not alter, regenerate, trim, replace or rerender the PB.6 video or contact sheet after preregistration.
Do not coach, infer, fabricate or normalize the human answers; record the reviewer's own allowed-answer tokens and optional notes.
Do not weaken a NO, UNCERTAIN or UNVIEWABLE into YES and do not omit an unfavorable answer.
If human review fails, retain FAIL and create only a later versioned improvement program; never rewrite PB.6 or PB.7 attempt-01.
Do not change the historical frame-288 threshold or reinterpret its rejection.
Do not create a release, distribute a binary or DMG, sign, notarize, force-push, update another ref, upload LFS or make account/legal changes.
claimCeiling: A PASS closes only this one inherited stylized B62 three-shot product prototype on one admitted arm64 host with one delayed human review. It does not prove final-film quality, photorealism, production readiness, public distribution, cross-platform behavior or autonomous filmmaking.
